deconstruction.scope: DAIOF/OpenClaw CI/CD governance and runtime topology
deconstruction.evidence_limit: Repository contracts are static; runtime health requires fresh observations from a trusted runtime-visible host.

focal_point: Evidence-based closure across declared topology and observed runtime reality.

rearchitecture.simple: Configure bounded adapters, observe runtime identity/version/health, sign the attestation, and verify it against the deployment path.
rearchitecture.safe: Unavailable, stale, mismatched, unsigned, or topology-unbound evidence blocks verification.
rearchitecture.sustainable: Adapter and topology digests make runtime evidence reproducible and invalidate stale contracts.
rearchitecture.scalable: A common evidence envelope supports additional agents without adding per-service deployment logic.

risk_graph.control: human approval plus forbidden direct-merge validation
